ui.title: CellPay Help
ui.subtitle: Quick answers about refills and orders.
ui.greeting: Hi! Pick a topic or type your question.
ui.fallback: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Try one of these topics, or email us.

refill_how: Choose your carrier, enter the phone number, choose a plan or amount, and pay with a credit or debit card.
You don't need to create an account or log in.
carriers: Choose your carrier below to see the available plans or refill amounts.
fee: Any service fee is shown at checkout before you pay, so you can review the total first.
declined: Please double-check your card details, phone number and plan before confirming.
Before paying again, check whether the first payment went through with "Check order status" below, or email us.
not_received: If your refill hasn't arrived within 30 minutes, contact support.
You can also check your order status here with the phone number and your checkout email (or the last 4 characters of your Order ID).
Please don't pay again while an order is still being confirmed.
no_account: No. You can check out as a guest.
Creating a CellPay account is optional.

lines: You can cancel Auto Pay yourself: tap "Unsubscribe From Autopay" below and enter the phone number on Auto Pay plus your checkout email (or the last 4 characters of your Order ID).
We confirm by email within 1 business day. Payments already made aren't refunded.
autopay.fallback: Prefer email? Write to support@getcellpay.com from the email you used at checkout, with the phone number on Auto Pay. We reply within 1 business day.

orderStatus.title: Check order status
orderStatus.intro: Enter the phone number you refilled and the email you used at checkout. You can use the last 4 characters of your Order ID instead.
orderStatus.verifierLabel: Checkout email or last 4 of Order ID
orderStatus.invalidVerifier: Enter your checkout email, or the last 4 letters or numbers of your Order ID.

result.pending: We're still confirming this payment. Please don't pay again. Check back in a few minutes; if your refill hasn't arrived within 30 minutes, contact support.
result.unconfirmed: We couldn't confirm this payment yet. Please don't pay again. Contact support and we'll check it for you.
result.failed: This payment didn't go through. If you see a charge for it, contact support before paying again.
result.not_found: We couldn't find an order with those details. Check the phone number and email (or Order ID), then try again, or contact support.
result.invalid: Please check the phone number and your checkout email (or the last 4 characters of your Order ID), then try again.
result.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later or contact support.
result.unavailable: Order status is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes or contact support.
result.error: Something went wrong. Please try again or contact support.

contact.title: Contact support
contact.intro: Send us a message about a refill or an order.
contact.hours: We typically respond within 24 hours on business days.
contact.cardWarning: Never share card details (card number, expiration date or security code) in this form.
contact.sent: Thanks! Your message was sent. We typically respond within 24 hours on business days.
contact.invalidContact: Enter a 10-digit phone number or a valid email.
contact.invalidMessage: Please enter a message (up to 1000 characters).
contact.invalidLast4: Enter the last 4 letters or numbers of your Order ID.
contact.rate_limited: You've sent several messages already. Please try again later, or email us.
contact.error: Your message couldn't be sent. Please try again, or email us.
contact.invalid: Please check your details and try again.
contact.unavailable: Messages are temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes, or email us.
